3H.1 Flatter is not godly and is not to be used.

moments.label: Awake and Return: Overcoming Babylon's Hypnosis
The 5 Signs of a Good Wife

points: Help, Lord; for the godly man ceaseth; for the faithful fail from among the children of men. They speak vanity every one with his neighbour. When we walked in, the four men was huddled up in the back, talking, strategizing. We came in there regular; we didn't know what was going on.

note.label: Awake and Return: Overcoming Babylon's Hypnosis

points: With flattering lips and with a double heart do they speak. They had flattering lips and a double heart because they never told us what it really was. They never updated us on how it was going to be run. We just came and sat down.

note.label: Awake and Return: Overcoming Babylon's Hypnosis

points: Who have said, With our tongue will we prevail; our lips are our own: who is lord over us? They said with their tongue they going to prevail, not knowing that we came there in brotherhood and sincere discussion to go over the scriptures. In their mind they said, we going to line them up and corner them off.

Officer Eli was reading so good and getting the scriptures so fast they couldn't believe it. That was the spirit of the Lord working. Nobody going to prevail against our heavenly father; his word will go out and reign through this earth.

note.label: Awake and Return: Overcoming Babylon's Hypnosis

points: For the oppression of the poor, for the sighing of the needy, now will I arise, saith the Lord; I will set him in safety from him that puffeth at him. That's what I wanted, because the Lord said he would rise up for us. They didn't want to discuss how we could get our community together. They didn't want to discuss salvation, repentance, the things that's needed to get to the kingdom of heaven. Their discussion was the trinity, did Christ have a father, things that wasn't hitting on what could help our community.

note.label: Awake and Return: Overcoming Babylon's Hypnosis

points: They speak vanity every one with his neighbour: with flattering lips and with a double heart do they speak. Double tongued. Don't let this be named amongst us.
The silver tried in the furnace of the earth is the elect, the righteous. All of us get tried: by your own personal sins, in your marriage, by how you deal with each other.
Purified seven times means you can fall seven times and still be purified. Seven is a number of completion, not a limit; you could fall more than seven times.

note.label: The 5 Signs of a Good Wife

points: Fall and get back up and the Lord preserves you from this generation for ever.
